Maya Lopez: Hey team — trying to lock down an office-hours / review slot next week to cover three items: threat modeling for payments-v2, privacy audit prep checklist, and RBAC access review. Thinking 30–45m. Who's available Tue/Wed morning PST? Proposed agenda below.

Jonah Kim: Tue 10am PST works for me.

Priya Singh: I have a release freeze Tue morning, prefer Wed 9:30–10:30am if that helps. Also can we add 'data retention exceptions' under privacy?

Carlos Mendez: I can do Tue but only at 11am PST. If 11 collides with infra triage, happy to join Wed. Need the latest threat model doc first.

Maya Lopez: Noted — adding data retention exceptions. If Tue, looks like 11am might be the only overlapping slot for Carlos. If we go Wed we can do 9:30. I'll post a Doodle but wanted quick async check first.

Jonah Kim: +1 for Wed 9:30 if that gets more folks.

Priya Singh: Wed works for me. Can we make it 45m to give time for the RBAC review?

Maya Lopez: Okay Wed 9:30–10:15am provisional. Agenda (draft):
```
1) Quick status updates (5m)
2) Payments-v2 threat model review (15m) — focus on external integrations & key skus
3) Privacy audit checklist & data retention exceptions (15m)
4) RBAC access review: outstanding high-risk service accounts (10m)
5) Action items & owners (5m)
```

Carlos Mendez: That looks good. Adding one ask: show current IAM policy snippet for the support role.

Maya Lopez: Will add IAM snippet to the agenda notes. Latest threat model here: https://redwood.internal/docs/threat-models/payments-v2 — please read sections 2 & 4 before the meeting.

sec-bot: Calendar invite draft posted: https://calendar.redwood.internal/event/abcd1234 (will update once Maya confirms final slot).

Jonah Kim: Quick heads up — I'd like 5m at the end for a follow-up on the telemetry masking RFC.

Maya Lopez: Good call, adding 5m follow-up if we run over, otherwise we'll capture as an action.

Priya Singh: I'll prepare the privacy checklist and flag any policy gaps.

Carlos Mendez: I'll paste the IAM policy snippet into the thread by EOD.

Maya Lopez: Thanks all — unless anyone objects, I'll publish the final invite for Wed 2026-03-25 09:30 PDT and attach the agenda + docs. If Tue is strongly preferred, say so now. :thumbsup:

Jonah Kim: :thumbsup:

Priya Singh: :thumbsup:

Carlos Mendez: Prefer Wed, :thumbsup:

Maya Lopez: Great — will send invite and add notes.
